summary: Stone Ridge Engineering is a small North Brunswick, NJ consulting engineering firm doing MEP/FP design, due diligence, feasibility studies, peer reviews and design/build project management for architects, owners, tenants, developers and brokers. It is principal-led by Robert Cioffi, P.E., who is also a licensed NJ electrical contractor, and it presents itself as a word-of-mouth, repeat-client business with no published hours, no careers page and no online quote path. The front door is essentially a phone number plus a contact form that does not submit.

facts.fact: Offers MEP/FP design plus due diligence reports, feasibility studies, design peer reviews, project management and design/build arrangements.

Serves architects, building owners, tenants, developers and real estate brokers across pharmaceutical, retail, higher education, data centers, new construction and science/technology; also a licensed electrical contractor.

Robert Cioffi is President and Senior Electrical Engineer, a registered Professional Engineer, licensed NJ electrical contractor and NSPE member, with 12+ years of experience; client logos shown include Munich RE, Advaxis, Sabert, National Business Parks and Freshii.
Single office: 1583 Livingston Avenue, Suite #4, North Brunswick, NJ 08902; phone (732) 658-6302. No email address, business hours or staff directory is published on the site.
Contact page tells visitors to fill out the form and says 'a representative will be in contact with you shortly', adding that for immediate assistance they should call.

Contact form has 5 fields (name, address, phone, email, comments) and a Submit button but posts to javascript:void(0); the page loads jQuery from plain http://code.jquery.com on an https page, so jQuery is undefined and the validation/ajax handlers never bind - the form has no working submit path.

Google Business Profile 'Stoneridge Engineering, LLC' shows category Engineering consultant, a 5.0 rating with no review count, the Livingston Ave address, phone and website, plus 'Claim this business', 'Add hours' and 'Add photos' prompts (unclaimed, no hours, no photos).
The site's viewport meta includes format-detection telephone=no and there are no tel: links, so the phone number is not tappable on a phone.

At 390 px the hamburger icon does nothing - the mmenu plugin depends on the blocked jQuery, and the menu container stays at opacity 0 after clicking - so mobile visitors cannot reach About, Services or Contact from the header.

Site is hand-coded static HTML with no meta description, no JSON-LD, no analytics, chat or booking widget, no sitemap.xml and no robots.txt (both 404); titles are page names only, e.g. 'Home | StoneRidge Engineering, LLC.'

The contact page's embedded Google Map iframe carries an October 2016 timestamp in its embed URL and renders as a tall blank block with only an 'Open in Maps' control, filling most of the 390 px viewport above the contact heading.
Third-party directory The Org lists Stone Ridge Engineering in the 11-50 employee band, with 5 people listed and 0 jobs posted.

operations_signals: Intake is a phone call to (732) 658-6302 or a free-text comments form with no scope questions (building type, square footage, systems, deadline), so a principal has to qualify every enquiry by hand (https://stoneridgeeng.com/contact.html)

No business hours anywhere on the site and none on the Google profile ('Add hours' prompt), so after-hours expectations are undefined (https://www.google.com/maps/search/Stone+Ridge+Engineering+North+Brunswick+NJ)
Service area described only as the 'New Jersey Tri-State area', with projects referenced 'throughout the U.S.'; no coverage radius or locations list (https://stoneridgeeng.com/mep-engineering.html)

Deliverables are document-heavy - due diligence reports, feasibility studies, peer reviews, design documents - each needing scoping plus a written proposal before work starts (https://stoneridgeeng.com/due-diligence.html)

The business says it is built on 'word of mouth, repeat customers, and long-standing connections', so there is no visible qualification or CRM step between an enquiry and the principal (https://stoneridgeeng.com/)
The contact form is inert at both desktop and phone widths and gives no error or confirmation, so a prospect who prefers web over phone simply disappears (https://stoneridgeeng.com/contact.html)
No client portal, file-transfer or drawing-issue tooling is visible on the site, so document exchange is off-site (email or similar) (https://stoneridgeeng.com/index.html)
hiring_signals: No careers or jobs page: the nav is Home, About, Services, Contact only and /careers.html returns 404 (https://stoneridgeeng.com/careers.html)
The Org shows 0 jobs posted for the company (https://theorg.com/org/stone-ridge-engineering)

No current job postings found for the firm in public searches; the only trace was an old Electrical Project Engineer reference on a staff member's profile, which is not evidence of a live vacancy (https://stoneridgeeng.com/contact.html)
review_themes: No readable customer reviews: the Google profile shows 5.0 with no review count or review text in the panel, and no Yelp, BBB, Angi or BuildZoom review content surfaced in searches (https://www.google.com/maps/search/Stone+Ridge+Engineering+North+Brunswick+NJ)

With no review text available, no themes about responsiveness, billing or scheduling could be sourced; the only service claims are the firm's own ('timely, efficient and cost effective solutions') (https://stoneridgeeng.com/)
tech_footprint: Hand-coded static HTML (index, about, contact, mep-engineering, due-diligence, feasibility-studies); no CMS, no blog, no project gallery or case studies (https://stoneridgeeng.com/about.html)
jQuery 1.11.3 pulled over http:// (blocked as mixed content) plus jquery.mmenu for the mobile nav - both dead, which breaks the mobile menu and the contact form (https://stoneridgeeng.com/index.html)
No analytics, tag manager, chat, booking, portal or email-marketing code in the page source (https://stoneridgeeng.com/index.html)
Zero structured data, no meta descriptions, generic page-name titles, no sitemap.xml, robots.txt 404 (https://stoneridgeeng.com/index.html)
One embedded Google Maps iframe on the contact page only, and it renders blank (https://stoneridgeeng.com/contact.html)
No published email address and telephone auto-detection disabled, so there is no click-to-call or mailto path (https://stoneridgeeng.com/contact.html)
growth_signals: Site claims 12+ years of experience and long-standing repeat clients but shows no dated project, award or news item (https://stoneridgeeng.com/about.html)
No expansion, new-location, hiring or award news found for the firm or its president in public searches (https://stoneridgeeng.com/about.html)

Inference: the web presence looks unmaintained since the mid-2010s - 2016-era map embed, jQuery 1.11-era stack, no copyright line - which points to a firm growing on referrals rather than marketing (https://stoneridgeeng.com/contact.html)
physical_signals: One office suite at 1583 Livingston Avenue, Suite #4, North Brunswick, NJ 08902, on the Route 1 / Livingston Ave commercial corridor (https://stoneridgeeng.com/contact.html)
No square footage, headcount, fleet or equipment stated by the business; a third-party directory estimates 11-50 employees (https://theorg.com/org/stone-ridge-engineering)

Work happens at client buildings and job sites: building and facility surveys and assessments, emergency/standby power systems, infrastructure design, construction-phase project management (https://stoneridgeeng.com/mep-engineering.html)
No public record specific to the firm (permit, inspection, OSHA establishment) surfaced; the NJ license report PDF that search engines cite now returns 404 (https://stoneridgeeng.com/about.html)
decision_maker: Robert Cioffi, President and Senior Electrical Engineer (P.E., licensed NJ electrical contractor) - https://stoneridgeeng.com/about.html

inferences.inference: Principal bottleneck: proposal writing, due diligence reports and client Q&A most likely queue behind Robert Cioffi.
inferences.reasoning: The about page names only Cioffi and refers to a 'fully licensed staff' without roles; no other engineer, PM or business-development contact is published anywhere on the site or the Google profile.

inferences.inference: Leads are being lost at the web front door, not at the sales conversation.
inferences.reasoning: The only intake paths are a non-tappable phone number and a form whose JavaScript never initialises and whose action is javascript:void(0); a prospect submitting it sees nothing happen.

inferences.inference: Realistic size is a handful of people (roughly 3-10), below the 11-50 directory band.
inferences.reasoning: The Org's own listing shows 5 people and no org chart; the site names one principal, has no staff page, and no jobs are posted - the 11-50 figure appears to be a directory default.

inferences.inference: The best agent fit is intake/qualification plus document drafting, not online booking.
inferences.reasoning: Their product is bespoke engineering documents priced per project; there is nothing bookable, but every enquiry needs the same qualifying questions (building type, size, existing systems, deadline, decision stage) before it reaches the principal.

inferences.inference: Mobile-first prospects are effectively locked out of the site's inner pages.
inferences.reasoning: At 390 px the hamburger does not open (menu stays at opacity 0) and no other nav is visible, so only the home page is reachable; the contact page can only be reached by direct URL.

data_gaps: No customer reviews retrievable: Google profile shows 5.0 without a count or text; Yelp, BBB, Angi returned nothing usable; BuildZoom and LinkedIn were blocked by Cloudflare bot checks; a Google web search returned a CAPTCHA (google.com/sorry).
Headcount unconfirmed by the company; only third-party directory bands (The Org: 11-50 band, 5 people listed).
Business hours unknown - absent from the site and the Google profile has no hours set.

NJ Division of Consumer Affairs Certificate of Authorization report (search results said it lists the firm's authorization and Cioffi's PE number) returned HTTP 404 when opened, so licence numbers were not verified; the state's form-based lookup was not used, to avoid submissions.
No job-board data: Indeed returned 403 and LinkedIn was blocked, so hiring activity is unknown beyond the missing careers page and 0 jobs on The Org.
No public records on physical operations (building permits, health inspection, OSHA establishment search) were found for this firm.
Email address, revenue, project pipeline and client references are not published.
